basic_info.description: Vacant and fully remodeled two-unit building is located in the vibrant Inner Sunset neighborhood just steps from Golden Gate Park and the shops and restaurants along Irving Street. Both full-floor flats offer 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, each featuring a spacious living room, dining area, private balcony, and in-unit washer/dryer. The interiors have been tastefully updated with modern kitchens and bathrooms, stylish cabinetry, quartz countertops and backsplashes, brand-new appliances, and double-pane windows throughout. Major system upgrades include a brand-new roof with skylight, updated electrical and plumbing systems, new furnaces, and new water heaters ensuring comfort and peace of mind for years to come.  The garage offers two-car tandem parking, generous storage space, high ceilings,  with expansion potential. A low-maintenance backyard is ideal for BBQs and outdoor gatherings.    Whether you're looking for a great investment or a home with rental income potential, this turnkey property delivers flexibility, functionality, and unbeatable location.
